newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds end mixed to higher, long bond leading.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds end mixed to higher, long bond leading.

text.p: 1515 GMT - Dutch bonds ended the day mixed to higher in which positive tone was lent by 30-year paper that was traded by professionals for arbitrage purposes. Technically picture is mixed, but Dutch paper still scantily available, supporting prices. Shortening trades to liquid 1998 paper. Early German M3 figures as expected and shrugged off by market.
* Jan 2006s flat at 100.91/01, yielding 5.87 percent, or 12 basis points below 10-year bunds.
* Jan 2023s +0.20 to 110.97/17, yielding 6.61 percent, or 22 basis points under long bunds.
